detail.longDescription: # UK # benefits department hit by # CyberIncident as attacks spread from # Tokyo to # Washington By Hannah Collymore, November 27, 2026 Excerpt: "This month, Richard Horne of the National # CyberSecurity Centre said there was a real chance of an unprecedented rise in # CyberIncidents . "In October, a serious flaw in PHP, a programming language used by most of the web, forced 32 government services offline, with four more partly down. The Department for Education also confirmed in July that about 607,000 records were exposed in a separate attack. "Are other countries experiencing cyber attacks? " # Japan declared its first # cybersecurity state of emergency in October. A breach at the # cloud company # IDCFrontier , which is owned by # SoftBankCorp . (TYO: 9434), spread to hundreds of its customers. Officials there estimated that the personal data of about 14 million people was exposed. "The # USTreasury ’s # FinancialCrimes Enforcement Network took its systems offline this week after someone gained # UnauthorizedAccess . Just hours earlier, intruders had reportedly broken into an open-source intelligence system shared by the # CIA , the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence. "President Donald Trump also separately confirmed that there was a hack of the # FBI ’s National # CrimeInformation Center. "Investigators suspect that some of these U.S. break-ins used # Artex , an # AITool that a Chinese engineer released in July to help defenders.
